ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Contemporary Issues in Global Advertising and Consumer Behavior. Meets with ADV 400-V (CRN 49682). This course introduces students to the understanding of culture from anthropological and psychological perspectives with a focus on subjective perceptions and shared understandings (values, attitudes, lifestyles, rituals). A variety of communication problems are presented through case studies, with emphasis on effectiveness and ethics, in a range of international contexts.
